title: Coprimality conjecture for binary-partition reciprocal polynomials
statement:
Let $\mathcal B(n)$ be the set of binary partitions of $n$, and let $\mathrm{num}_{\mathcal B}(n,x)$ and $\mathrm{den}_{\mathcal B}(n,x)$ denote the associated numerator and denominator polynomials. **Binary-partition coprimality conjecture.** For every $n\geq 1$, 
$$
\gcd\bigl(\mathrm{num}_{\mathcal B}(n,x),\mathrm{den}_{\mathcal B}(n,x)\bigr)=1.
$$
 This is identified as the main conjecture for binary partitions and remains open.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10512

Status: **open** according to the source (as of May 2026). “In Section , we discuss open questions for sums of reciprocals of subsum polynomials defined on restricted sets of partitions.”
source_name: Cristina Ballantine, George Beck, Brooke Feigon and Kathrin Maurischat, “Reciprocals of Subsum Polynomials”, arXiv:2605.10512 (2026).
